errors.ssoHtmlResponse: Received an HTML response instead of JSON from the API. If you are behind an SSO proxy (Cloudflare Access, Pangolin, etc.), try refreshing the page or re-opening the URL in a new tab.

themeToggle.premiumThemeError: This theme needs a license. Open Settings → Themes to activate one.

recording_stopped.title: Recording stopped
recording_stopped.effect: qui cannot write the transfer history. It tries again at the next write.
recording_stopped.fix: Make sure that the disk has free space and that qui can write its database file.
recording_stopped.menuFix: Free disk space for the database

shrink_failed.title: Shrink failed
shrink_failed.effect: qui could not make the database file smaller. The database did not change, and qui runs as usual.
shrink_failed.fix: The qui log has the details.

disk_full.fix: The disk has too little free space. A shrink needs up to two times the size of the database file. Free space on the disk, then try again.
disk_full.menuFix: Free disk space, then try again

locked.fix: Another program held the database file. Stop that program, for example a backup tool or a database viewer, then try again.
locked.menuFix: Stop the other program, then try again

redacted_key_rejected.title: Redacted rejected the API key
redacted_key_rejected.effect: qui does not search Redacted until you paste a new key.
redacted_key_rejected.fix: Make an API key with the Torrents permission in your Redacted profile settings, and paste it in the RED/OPS settings of qui.
redacted_key_rejected.menuFix: Paste a new key in settings

orpheus_key_rejected.title: Orpheus rejected the API key
orpheus_key_rejected.effect: qui does not search Orpheus until you paste a new key.
orpheus_key_rejected.fix: Make an API key with the Torrents permission in your Orpheus profile settings, and paste it in the RED/OPS settings of qui.
orpheus_key_rejected.menuFix: Paste a new key in settings

unknown.title: System notice
unknown.effect: qui found a fault that needs an action from you.
unknown.fix: The qui log has the details.

databaseShrink.nextStart: The shrink runs at the next start of qui
